subject: curved handmade paper folds
pose: two folds rising low across the frame
art_direction: 米白纸张的弯折像低矮沙丘，近处纤维在浅暖光下清晰可见。
visible_description: 米白纸张的弯折像低矮沙丘，近处纤维在浅暖光下清晰可见。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Study two broad folds of handmade cream paper as miniature dunes. Close fibers and a few embedded pale strands appear on the nearest ridge, while soft warm light turns the fold into a long graceful shadow. Keep the paper pristine and unprinted. A shallow focus gradient dissolves the upper surface into a naturally quiet off-white field. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
